stem: Two irrigation zones use the same media and receive the same event volume, but one zone now dries back much faster after a sustained increase in light and air movement. What is the best management response?
choices: Keep both irrigation schedules unchanged because identical media should outweigh the environmental difference between zones
Increase fertilizer concentration in the faster-drying zone so the plants receive more dissolved material per event
Reduce air movement and light in the faster-drying zone until its dryback rate matches the other zone
Reassess irrigation timing using measured depletion and current environmental demand in the faster-drying zone
rationale: Water demand can change with environmental conditions even when media and programmed event volume are unchanged. Irrigation timing should respond to measured root-zone depletion and current crop demand.
